snippet.title: Super World War - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Super World War is coming on PC & Nintendo Switch on August 25th 2025

The world has gone mad and it's time to spread the chaos!

Super World War is a turn-based strategy game with funny generals and great tactical depth which
Super World War will allow games up to 4 players (online and offline), controlling different armies with their own special weapon.

Download FREE DEMO now on Steam !!

Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473580/Super_World_War/
